release.label: Public research preview
release.detail: iPhone smoke + one Duo video trial · full acceptance pending
release.publicStatus: Source is public as a research preview. The iPhone 16 profile scenario and 26-step CounterLab smoke passed. One closed-Duo session rendered local fixture video and recovered playback after a 666.58-second pause. iPad display classification also recovered in a preserved guest. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation; repeatable cold startup, general app performance, and complete profile acceptance remain pending.

guest.label: iPhone 16 compatible run
guest.detail: A fresh iPhone 16 guest running iOS 27.0.1, build 24A446, completed ordinary Setup Assistant through the UI without setup or migration marker edits. The controlled 12-step profile scenario passed OS, UIKit idiom, point-size, and scale checks. A separate compatible-graphics CounterLab smoke passed all 26 steps, including reset and increment, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode text input, Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The note is transient. DataMigrator success: false leaves clean creation unaccepted.

sample.label: CounterLab · SDK 27.2
sample.detail: CounterLab's warm Release build took 3.03 seconds with the Xcode 27.2 SDK. This proves the build step only and does not measure app performance.

runtime.label: Native runtime proof
runtime.detail: The 26-step compatible-graphics CounterLab smoke passed in one iPhone 16 run. A separate closed-Duo session rendered BruTV's local H.264 HLS fixture; physical Play restored video 3.28 seconds after a 666.58-second pause, and source counters advanced in later captures. This is one recovery trial, not a general playback or app-performance result. iPad framebuffer density and ProgressUI screen classification now match the profile after cache refresh and reboot. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation. Repeatable cold startup and complete iPhone, Duo, and iPad acceptance remain pending.
runtime.faq: The 26-step CounterLab smoke passed on one compatible-graphics iPhone 16 guest. One closed-Duo session rendered BruTV's local H.264 HLS fixture; physical Play restored video 3.28 seconds after a 666.58-second pause, with source counters advancing in later captures. This does not establish broad playback reliability or app performance. The iPad's native framebuffer density and ProgressUI screen classification now match its profile after cache refresh and reboot. Fresh creation, migration, repeatable cold startup, and complete profile acceptance remain pending.

microbenchmark.title: Self-modifying code · QEMU microbenchmark
microbenchmark.description: 32 KiB code-copy workload, nine allocated vCPU caches, three interleaved runs. Rewritten instructions were validated after each run.
microbenchmark.scope: This is a QEMU cache-invalidation microbenchmark. It does not measure app startup, interaction latency, graphics performance, or user-visible speed.
